findings.title: Two signing subkeys are still valid although newer ones replaced them
findings.reason: Anyone who holds the card that made them can still sign as you until March or April 2027, and nobody would see the difference. They sit on card 00000102, which is not in your inventory.
evidence: 1B220123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123: signing subkey of 2022, valid until 2027-03-14, replaced by the 2025 set
1B320123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123: signing subkey of 2023, valid until 2027-04-02, replaced by the 2025 set
Neither has a revocation. Both are on card 00000102.

findings.title: The primary key has no expiry, and adoption should have set one
findings.reason: ritueel gives an adopted key an expiry at adoption. This one arrived without, and the adoption did not set one: that is a gap. A key without an expiry stays valid for ever if you lose track of it, while one with an expiry that you extend is a safety net: forgotten keys die by themselves.
evidence: RSA-4096 primary, created 2012-06-19, no expiry set
Adopted on 2026-11-03; the adoption did not set an expiry

findings.title: Subkeys sit on 2 cards that are not in your inventory
findings.reason: You cannot revoke or replace what you cannot find. If one of these cards is lost, you will not know which keys it took with it.
evidence: Card 00000102: 4 subkey sets, 2020 to 2023, 2 signing subkeys still valid

findings.title: One user ID looks like a misspelling of another
findings.reason: People who look you up may pick the wrong one, and a name that is nearly yours is also how a look-alike key is made. Revoke the one you did not mean.
evidence: "Exmaple Holder <holder@example.com>" differs from "Example Holder <holder@example.com>" by two letters swapped

findings.title: The signing key on "Day-to-day, keychain" now asks for a touch only once in a while
findings.reason: The last reading differs from the one before: the touch rule was always and is now cached. A cached touch lets a program on your computer sign several times after one touch.
evidence: Slot sig: touch rule cached (was always) at the reading of 2026-11-04

findings.title: Your primary is RSA-4096, adopted as it is (stage one)
findings.reason: ritueel accepts an old key once, with its history. Stage two uses card-born keys. Replace it within three years, or move to stage two with two card-born primaries.
evidence: Row 2 of both root cards is reserved for stage two

findings.title: The rehearsal card cannot become a root card
findings.reason: A card that holds roots needs firmware 5.7.4 or later, so that one half-born key can be removed without resetting the card. The rehearsal card runs 5.2.6. That is fine for practice.
evidence: Firmware 5.2.6, floor for a root card 5.7.4
